reference: Cox, D. R. (1958). Two Further Applications of a Model for Binary Data. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B, 20(2), 394-397.

estimation_methodology.input_probabilities: Raw holdout predicted probabilities (p_hat) from selected classifier (XGBoost)

protocol_declarations.transformation_policy: Holdout labels are strictly used to assess calibration slope and intercept. Holdout probabilities are NOT altered, rescaled, or transformed post-hoc. Reported screening, discrimination, and Brier metrics reflect the original raw model probabilities.
protocol_declarations.threshold_selection_policy: Operating decision threshold (t* = 0.13) was selected exclusively on development out-of-fold (OOF) cross-validation predictions to achieve target recall >= 0.80, completely isolated from holdout calibration modeling.
protocol_declarations.uncertainty_quantification: 1,000 stratified bootstrap resamples on the holdout evaluation partition to construct 2.5th and 97.5th percentile 95% confidence intervals.

interpretation.slope_less_than_1: Predictions are moderately over-dispersed (extreme probabilities slightly too extreme)
interpretation.negative_intercept: Predictions systematically slightly overestimate risk (average predicted probability exceeds empirical prevalence)

primary_stratified_evaluation.status: Modest systematic calibration deviation; slope 95% CI strictly below 1.0; intercept 95% CI strictly below 0.0.

profile_grouped_redevelopment_sensitivit.status: Slope 95% CI spans 1.0; intercept 95% CI spans 0.0.
